name: AbsoluteJS public voice benchmark corpus
purpose: Reproducible evaluation of streaming speech recognition, turn timing, critical-field capture, and adverse audio conditions.
unit: One PCM utterance or explicitly documented synthetic concatenation.

collections.source: LibriSpeech public-domain source material plus documented deterministic derivatives
George Mason University Speech Accent Archive

speakerMetadata: Public source metadata is limited to the source archive and country/language tags in manifest.json; demographic attributes are not inferred.
consentAndPrivacy: Only public research corpus audio is bundled. Customer recordings and identifiers are prohibited from this repository.
knownLimitations: The bundled corpus is small and cannot establish population-wide accuracy.
Several dialogue fixtures are synthetic concatenations, not natural conversations.
The Speech Accent Archive subset is noncommercial and must be reported separately from the permissive core.
A private held-out corpus is required for deployment-specific claims.

evaluationPolicy.development: May be used to tune implementation and prompts.
evaluationPolicy.public-test: References are visible; report prompt track and treat oracle-seeded results separately.
evaluationPolicy.private-held-out: References are unavailable to provider configuration and correction logic until scoring.
